options.content:
### Internet connection
Public egress information for each selected **probe node**, not your browser. Looked up every five minutes via [ipwho.is](https://ipwhois.io/). Location is approximate. VPNs, NAT and proxies may identify the exit provider instead of the physical ISP. Only the default egress address family is shown; this does not identify every uplink. The Target filter applies only to Backhaul.

A failed lookup clears the details. Check lookup status, exporter reachability and age below.

spec.title: Last successful lookup age
spec.description: No value until the first successful lookup.
